name: sacrifice-play-sacrificing-two-chessman-allies-gives-plus-four-power
notes: Sacrifice Play: sacrifice two awake Pawn Pieces as the additional cost, pay 3, command with the last Pawn Piece. The additional cost used to be skipped entirely: no ally was sacrificed and the attack dealt only its base 2.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Sacrifice Play's additional cost (sacrifice up to two awake Chessman allies, +2 POWER each when it enters the intent) was never implemented: its SacrificePlayCost1/2 handlers were never queued and the power code read a counter nothing wrote (an Intent object has no counters), so no ally was sacrificed and no bonus applied. Fix: DoActivateCard declares the cost (one up-to-two multi-choose, SacrificePlayCost sacrifices them, queued with dontSkipOnPass so a declined sacrifice still pays the reserve cost); the count rides on the intent card's SACRIFICE_PLAY_<n> turn effect.
